decision: The request was marked closed (event-032) while two of the playbook's final checks were unevidenced: no invoice on file or forwarded (event-030) and no landlord confirmation (event-031 is followed by closure 56 seconds later, with no landlord message after event-022). facts.statement: Tenant Amelia Nolan reported on 29 Nov 2026 that the dishwasher at Flat 12, 78 Copperfield Walk fills and washes but never ends its cycle; started recently.
Agency intake classified the issue as ROUTINE — no loss of essential service, no hazard.
Landlord authorised instructing a contractor on 3 Dec 2026 ('Yes please go ahead').
Oakfield Homes was assigned and briefed on 6 Dec 2026; the tenant was told they would attend.

Provider reported on 7 Dec 2026: water in the base removed, loose connection from the flow-through heater tightened and retested, appliance running as it should; a missing dial needs replacing, quoted £95 including parts, labour and VAT, parts to be ordered.
Landlord approved the £95 incl. VAT quote on 7 Dec 2026 and the provider was instructed to proceed the same day.

Completion is asserted only by system status lines; the two provider notes of 13 Dec carry no text.

No landlord standing spend cap is on file in this case record; authority for the £95 rests on the landlord's own messages.
